sections.text: # FINDINGS — PR-B3 Terminal Condition Sub-Taxonomy Classification

**Paper**: PR-B3 (chron-terminal-conditions)
**Date**: 2026-04-20
**Scope**: 115 locked LUCIA chapters (2026-04-14 through 2026-04-18)
**Classifier**: Project editor (LUCY / human-in-loop), single-pass with second-pass reconciliation
**Taxonomy applied**: v1.6 10 formalized types + v1.7 8 endogenous-institutional candidates = **18 candidate types**
**Auxiliary category**: Ongoing (arc not terminated in covered period) — added after first-pass review
**Falsification thresholds (pre-registered)**:
- > 20% unclassified after first-pass → taxonomy incomplete
- > 30% unclassified after second-pass → taxonomy cannot be closed at corpus size
